originalTitle: Trump backs 'fantastic' Warsh while calling for lower rates and citing 'bad intentions' of other Fed officials
summary: President Trump Monday voiced support for Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh while insisting that the U.S. should have the lowest interest rates in the world.
content:
President Donald Trump on Monday voiced support for Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh while insisting that the U.S. should have the lowest interest rates in the world.

While backing his choice to lead the central bank, Trump questioned the motives of other members of the Fed's Board of Governors for not wanting to ease monetary policy.

"Kevin's fantastic, but he's got a board, and the board members are very political, I would say," the president said during a session with reporters on Air Force One. "He wants to do the right thing. I know what he wants to do."

The president's comments came two days before the bank's Federal Open Market Committee, or FOMC, releases its latest interest rate decision. Markets are pricing in a strong chance that officials will vote to stay on hold, as they have all year, though they're leaving open about a 1-in-3 chance of quarter percentage point hike, according to the CME Group's FedWatch tool.

Several Fed officials in recent days have expressed concern about persistently high inflation. Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan, a voting FOMC member this year, was the most explicit in calling for tighter policy , saying benchmark rates should be "modestly higher."

In his remarks, Trump, as he has done in the past, accused Fed officials of having ulterior motives.

"You need the consent of some people that have perhaps bad intentions. Rates should be lowered. This country could be at 8%, 9%, 10%, 12% [annualized growth of] GDP. That's what it should be," he said.

"We should have the lowest interest rate in the world, like it used to be 30 years ago," he added.

The Fed's benchmark overnight borrowing rate is currently targeted in a range between 3.5%-3.75%, where it has been since the central bank lowered by three-quarters of a percentage point in second half of 2025.

The rate is essentially the same as the Bank of England, but is above the 2.25% for the European Central Bank, Japan's 1% and China's 3%.
chineseTitle: 特朗普支持“出色的”沃什，同时呼吁降低利率并引用其他美联储官员的“不良意图”
chineseSummary: 特朗普总统周一表示支持美联储主席凯文·沃什，同时坚称美国应该拥有世界上最低的利率。
chineseContent:
美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周一表示支持美联储主席凯文·沃什，同时坚称美国应该拥有世界上最低的利率。

在支持自己领导美联储的选择的同时，特朗普质疑美联储理事会其他成员不想放松货币政策的动机。

“凯文太棒了，但他有一个董事会，而且我想说，董事会成员非常政治化，”总统在空军一号上接受记者采访时说。 “他想做正确的事。我知道他想做什么。”

总统发表此番言论的两天前，美联储联邦公开市场委员会 (FOMC) 发布了最新利率决定。根据芝加哥商品交易所集团的美联储观察工具，市场预计官员们投票维持利率不变的可能性很大，正如他们全年所做的那样，尽管他们对加息四分之一个百分点的可能性持开放态度。

多位美联储官员近日表达了对持续高通胀的担忧。达拉斯联储主席洛里·洛根（Lorie Logan）是今年有投票权的联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）成员，他最明确地呼吁收紧政策，表示基准利率应该“适度提高”。

特朗普在讲话中一如既往地指责美联储官员别有用心。

“你需要得到一些可能怀有恶意的人的同意。利率应该降低。这个国家的GDP[年增长率]可能达到8%、9%、10%、12%。这就是它应该的样子，”他说。

“我们应该拥有世界上最低的利率，就像 30 年前那样，”他补充道。

美联储基准隔夜借款利率目前目标在3.5%-3.75%之间，这是自2025年下半年央行降息四分之三个百分点以来的水平。

该利率与英国央行基本相同，但高于欧洲央行的2.25%、日本的1%和中国的3%。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于财经市场信号，适合用于观察利率、汇率、股债商品、金融机构和宏观政策变化。
